inline_helpers.name: hsg box / hsg decision / hsg arrow / hsg label (TikZ styles)
args: hsg box=<colour>; picture keys hsg box height, hsg box width
inline_helpers.purpose: Diagram boxes that share one height and width per picture, so rows are symmetric.

inline_helpers.name: hsg chart / hsg bars (pgfplots styles)
inline_helpers.purpose: Chart styling: scriptsize fonts, left axes, dashed grid, HSG colour cycle. With several bar series set xtick explicitly.

rules_to_follow: Three pdflatex passes. remember-picture overlays settle on pass 2-3.
HSG green is reserved for the sidebar, page badge, and \hsgemph. Never use it for frame titles, framesubtitles, or column headers.
Copy ALL hsg-* assets and the fonts/ directory next to your .tex file.
Sidebar wants 4-6 sections in \hsgsetsections; the same items should appear in \hsgagenda.
Cover and closing layouts are hand-tuned. Do not redefine their templates.
Boxes in one diagram share one height (the tallest) and one width: use hsg box with hsg box height/width on the picture.
Tables: hsgtable with grid, shaded header, alternating rows; every cell starts with a capital letter.
Takeaway boxes carry the label 'Takeaway.'; definitions the label 'Definition.'.
